name: DarX
origin: Born in Abu Dhabi. Built for the world.
purpose: To make complex experience information meaningful, comparable and useful for every person, business and city.
mission: To transform fragmented ratings, reviews, data and feedback into impartial, explainable intelligence that helps people choose better and organizations improve faster.
vision: One universal standard for how experience quality is measured. Universal in method. Local in judgement.
promise: We turn many signals into the right fit, the right action and the right benchmark, powered by the principles of Emotional Infrastructure.

outcomes.FIND: Discover suitability by need, mood, criteria and context.
outcomes.IMPROVE: Turn feedback into focused, evidence-led action.
outcomes.CITY BENCHMARK: Compare experience quality across equivalent criteria.

units.DarX Intelligence: Measure: data intelligence, benchmarking and reports.
units.DarX Strategy: Shape: strategy, policy, transformation and advisory.
units.DarX Labs: Advance: AI innovation, behavioural science and applied research.
units.DarX Institute: Define: standards, certification, research and thought leadership.
